Info

Defines interface IScaraDslService coordinating high-level SCARA DSL compilation and export.

class scarajectory.core.service.dsl.iscara_dsl_service.IScaraDslService(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

High-level orchestration service for SCARA DSL source processing.

It defines:

methods:
compile_script - Compiles DSL source code into executable TrajectoryPlan.
validate_script - Checks syntax and kinematics of DSL script.
lint_script - Performs static analysis checks on DSL script string.
export_plan - Serializes active TrajectoryPlan to DSL source text.

_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
compile_script(*, source: str, bounds: ScaraBounds | None = None) → TrajectoryPlan[source]¶

Compiles DSL source code into an executable and validated TrajectoryPlan.

Parameters:

  • source – Raw .scara script text.

  • bounds – Optional robot kinematic boundary constraints.

Returns:

Validated TrajectoryPlan instance.

Exceptions:

ValueError if parsing or kinematic validation fails.

export_plan(*, plan: ITrajectoryPlan) → str[source]¶

Serializes active TrajectoryPlan into formatted .scara DSL source text.

Parameters:

plan – TrajectoryPlan instance to serialize.

Returns:

Formatted SCARA DSL script.

Exceptions:

None.

source – Raw .scara script text.

validate_script(*, source: str, bounds: ScaraBounds | None = None) → tuple[bool, list[str]][source]¶

Validates syntax and kinematic feasibility of a DSL script without mutating active plan.

Parameters:

  • source – Raw .scara script text.

  • bounds – Optional robot kinematic boundary constraints.

Tuple of (is_valid, messages_list).

None.
